tools.name: get_cmbs_rates
tools.description: Median original note rates on CMBS loans securitized in the last 90 days, 180 days and 12 months, from SEC Form ABS-EE loan data, overall or for one property type, with the middle half, loan counts, the 5- vs 10-year split and recent months. Rates on closed loans, not a quote.

tools.description: What CMBS lenders actually underwrote in the last 12 months, from SEC loan data: loan size, loan to value, debt service coverage, debt yield and occupancy (median and percentiles), interest-only share and 5/10-year term mix, overall or for one property type.

tools.name: get_cmbs_lender
tools.description: One CMBS originator's securitized book from SEC filings: 12- and 24-month volume, loan sizes, median rate, leverage, property types, states and its most recent loans (property, city, amount, rate, term, trust). Give the lender's name or slug, e.g. "Citi" or "wells-fargo".

tools.name: get_cmbs_maturity_wall
tools.description: CMBS loans still reporting, by maturity year: count, balance, average note rate and the share whose NOI at securitization is under 9% of today's balance (a rough refinance-gap proxy), compared with today's median new-loan rate. Overall, by property type or by state (one filter at a time).
